# Cycle19 algebra handoff

The strongest deliverable is a certificate-producing service for a **supplied finite colored-graph witness**. An independently reconstructed theorem reduces the source's all-seed condition to singleton-image closure and binary lattice joins. For a k-element carrier, at most binom(k,2)(k−1) explicit unary operation tables suffice to realize the entire asserted congruence lattice; their certificate uses O(k⁴ log k) bits. Verification is polynomial in the explicit carrier/color/lattice tables. The acquired operations certify full congruences, rather than just an embedding into equivalence relations.

The executable map acquirer uses endpoint-pinned binary constraints, exact forward checking and bounded search. It can still take exponential search time. Its positive verifier needs no map-enumeration oracle, all-seed enumeration or external solver. A cap returns BUDGET_UNKNOWN; a defect rejects this supplied graph, not representability of the abstract lattice. Independent small controls enumerate all maps, all seed subsets and all equivalence relations to assess the smaller operation list. The universal result is the proof, not those controls. See [proof](</Users/harjas/Documents/ChatGPT/Literature Digestion/notes/hessian_check12/cycle19/SMALL_FULL_CONGRUENCE_CERTIFICATES.md>) and [implementation](</Users/harjas/Documents/ChatGPT/Literature Digestion/work/hessian_check12/cycle19/colored_graph_certificate.py>).

The division-algebra branch produces an exact obstruction to a proposed direct modular port. The regular net x²+yz, y²+xz, z²+xy has no nonzero scalar square in its span in characteristic other than7, over every field extension. Regularity holds in characteristic other than2. A finite-dimensional division algebra with finite center is a finite field by Wedderburn, so the selected manuscript's last triangular row cannot exist for this net over any finite center of characteristic outside{2,7}. This blocks the exact division interface, while leaving positive-characteristic transcendental centers and different modular constructions open.

Splitting into matrix coefficients does not repair that interface automatically. A commuting pair with a full ordered monomial module basis and a central regular-sequence ideal has two occupied degree-one leading exponents but normalized degree-one dimension1.
